item.title: National Park centre hosts Connected in Connemara
item.description: Connected: Connemara, a joint exhibition from artists Siobhán Moore and Elaine Cunningham that celebrates friendship, shared journeys and their creative expression, is currently running in the Visitor Centre of Connemara National Park. item.title: Galway poet Stephen wins first Gerald Dawe bursary
item.description: Galway city poet Stephen de Búrca has been selected as the recipient of the inaugural Home Again Gerald Dawe Poetry Bursary, in memory of the late poet, who died in 2024. item.title: Galway City Council on the brink of deal for Pálás
item.description: Galway City Council is nearing a deal to secure the future operation of Pálás Cinema, the Galway City Tribune understands.
